S-AX section check for the thermal mapping (fea3d 2026-10-20 14:3xZ; brief item: "S-AX now cuts TC-02 at az 78 deg (az 90 hits a tap
with the 10x M5 pattern at 18 + 36k): check that your thermal mapping from S-AX uses the 78 deg section").

My 3-D thermal map takes T(r, z) from Mechanical's v3.5.2 S-AX runs (the mesh.npz of each run).  An S-AX section through a J-FWD tap
(az 90 = 18 + 2 x 36) would show the tap as a void in TC-02 over r 21.3-28.6 mm, |z - 127.513| < 2.5 mm (tap D 5, axis z 127.513, tip
x' 21.313); a section between taps (az 78: 12 deg from the az 90 tap, whose half-width at r 28 is 5.1 deg) shows full material there.
Test: count TC-02 elements of the S-AX mesh with their centroid inside that envelope, and the largest radial gap between TC-02 element
centroids along z 127.513 +- 0.3 mm.  Read-only on Mechanical's run tree.

GVLO.verdict: full material over the tap envelope: the section misses the J-FWD taps (consistent with the az 78 cut)

GVHI.verdict: full material over the tap envelope: the section misses the J-FWD taps (consistent with the az 78 cut)
